theorems.name: Submission.p09_af497904fe_luf_frobenius_tower_limit
theorems.statement: ∀ (F : ℕ → IntermediateField ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)) (hmono : Monotone F), (∀ i : ℕ, FiniteDimensional ℚ (F i)) → (∀ i : ℕ, IsGalois ℚ (F i)) → (∀ x : AlgebraicClosure ℚ, ∃ i : ℕ, x ∈ F i) → ∀ (V : (i : ℕ) → ValuationSubring (F i)) (ℓ : ℕ), (∀ i : ℕ, (V i).LiesOverPrime ℓ) → (∀ (i j : ℕ) (hij : i ≤ j) (x : F i), IntermediateField.inclusion (hmono hij) x ∈ V j ↔ x ∈ V i) → (∀ i : ℕ, ∃ g : F i ≃ₐ[ℚ] F i, (V i).IsFrobeniusAt g ℓ) → ∃ P : ValuationSubring (AlgebraicClosure ℚ), P.LiesOverPrime ℓ ∧ (∀ (i : ℕ) (x : F i), (x : AlgebraicClosure ℚ) ∈ P ↔ x ∈ V i) ∧ ∃ τ : AlgebraicClosure ℚ ≃ₐ[ℚ] AlgebraicClosure ℚ, P.IsFrobeniusAt τ ℓ ∧ ∀ i : ℕ, ∃ g : F i ≃ₐ[ℚ] F i, (V i).IsFrobeniusAt g ℓ ∧ ∀ x : F i, τ (x : AlgebraicClosure ℚ) = ((g x : F i) : AlgebraicClosure ℚ)
theorems.natural_summary: Combines accepted restriction, finite inverse-limit, automorphism-gluing, and valuation-union declarations to assemble the tower limit.
